source: EPC domestic bulk export (Energy Performance of Buildings certificates)
method: Certificates deduplicated by UPRN, aggregated by postcode sector, assigned to areas within 1.61km.
caveats: Covers only dwellings with an EPC — sold or let since 2008. Long-held family homes are under-represented.
Positioned by postcode sector, not exact address.
Construction age is the assessor's banding, not a survey.
